authority: User approval of room-layout-v2.png and furniture-models-v1.png; room-facing orientation wins over catalogue presentation

reference.rect_convention: x,y,width,height; right and bottom exclusive; all source_px coordinates below are in the full approved room image unless named furniture_sheet
reference.crop_policy: Reference crops only; regenerate clean components. Never ship a mock crop. Approved rug extends beyond lower scene edge; produce its whole silhouette.

camera.projection: shallow front-facing illustrative 2.5D, approximately orthographic; not isometric and not a mathematically consistent one-point perspective
camera.visual_axis: verticals stay vertical, back-wall horizontal rails stay nearly horizontal, tops visible, left-side chair sees its LEFT exterior side, central and right furniture see shallow RIGHT exterior sides
camera.world_axes: X horizontal normalized room width; Z projected floor depth normalized from rear floor y=610 to front y=813; H height in the same 203-pixel projected unit. This is an art placement coordinate system, not metres or reconstructed physical 3D.
camera.global_light: warm daylight from upper left window; cooler ambient shadow on right/underneath; keep contact shadows separable from object art
camera.pixel_language: crisp clustered pixel illustration, warm timber/cream/sage/dusty blue. No photo texture, vector simplification, blur or new outlines. Preserve source pixel grouping when normalizing; resample once, nearest-neighbour.

composition.pet_policy: Pet is a live separate sprite; scene plate, rug and bed contain no Pokemon. Ground polygon excludes furniture/pot/bed contact footprints, not pet heads or alpha silhouette bounding rectangles. Pet may visually overlap background cabinet.

furniture_slots.orientation: nearly frontal, shallow visible top; right side on non-round variants; do not rotate table into catalogue diagonal
furniture_slots.swap_rule: Keep ground anchor, recompute support from selected model. Plant follows tabletop height; no world-fixed hovering pot. The approved mug is not part of reusable furniture.

furniture_slots.orientation: front face almost square to viewer, narrow visible RIGHT side, shallow top. No catalogue three-quarter exaggeration.
furniture_slots.swap_rule: Three trophy IDs survive all C1-C4 swaps. Shelf baseline and top plant support come from that model. Lower books are intrinsic C3 art; trophy, plant and trophy shadow pixels must never be baked into body/lip.

furniture_slots.orientation: Faces inward toward centre/right. LEFT outer side visible in approved room. All A variants must be drawn at this same placement angle; do not use catalogue right-side views or mirror lighting blindly.
furniture_slots.swap_rule: Preserve seat height around scene y=654 and ground anchor. Optional cushion/throw shown in model sheet belongs to that model, not a fifth decor slot.

furniture_slots.orientation: near-frontal, shallow visible RIGHT side, top recedes up/right. Tall D3 remains visibly narrower; never scale all models to equal widths.
furniture_slots.swap_rule: Keep ground anchor, preserve characteristic heights/widths. Dresser books from room demonstration are separate optional set dressing, not intrinsic D2 or a user-configurable inventory model.

trophy_slots.placement: Bottom centre of trophy base sits on model shelf support, not sprite canvas bottom. Keep feet behind front shelf lip. Per-model support delta: C1=0, C2=-4, C3=0, C4=-6 relative to y=510.
trophy_slots.lighting: Do not recolour trophies when changing cabinet. Contact shadow sits on shelf plane below base, clipped to shelf interior. Glass/metal highlight remains consistent with left window.
trophy_slots.catalogue_scope_note: Parent supplies 63-appearance production inventory. ACHIEVEMENTS.md alone still enumerates 16 independent goals; do not invent the other three visual identities from geometry.

plant_slots.order: window then plant then near sill edge; curtain silhouette must not obscure pot or full canopy
table top then plant; support follows selected model
cabinet then pot/canopy; approved vine may trail down LEFT outer stile only, never over trophy cells or paintings
plant_slots.note: The approved room has a trailing vine although DECOR.md lists six small species. Treat its placement as canopy/occlusion evidence; do not invent an eleventh purchasable plant.

plant_slots.order: after chair because contact depth and approved overlap place plant leaves in front of chair's left edge; retain natural alpha gaps

picture_policy: All 12 pictures fit any of the three wall slots with uniform scaling to slot envelope, never stretch. Frame is physical scene object and may be raster with artwork; UI card border is not. Vertical paintings letterbox in room using clear wall pixels, never opaque padding within asset.

window.curtain_rule: Pair plus rod is one independent replaceable layer, or pair/rod split if intrinsic edge clipping requires it. Preserve an open centre and plant-safe sill. No window scenery/plant baked into curtains.

layer_order.policy: 12 switchable room-registered wall plates, structural beam/window holes aligned
timber floor; no furniture, rug, pet or furniture shadows
fixed timber posts/baseboards/window frame/outdoor scene; illumination overlay separable where floor/wall changes

produce.dimensions: logical_draw_wh per model; preferred >=4x logical master for small cutouts; actual emitted atlas size measured
produce.deviations: Catalogue chair orientation corrected to approved room orientation. Mug/dresser demonstration books omitted as independent incidental props.

produce.strategy: whole floor-plane clean artwork, faithful shape/pattern with approved 4 models x3 palettes
produce.deviations: Complete lower edge missing in mock must be reconstructed, not cropped.

produce.strategy: four finishes x3 palettes as registered wall plates. Generate clean walls without furniture, paintings, window, UI; architecture composes separately
three models x2 palettes, whole empty bed, scene-facing angle

produce.strategy: 11 x4 staged compositions and19 independent miniatures, all separate from cabinets
empty clean plate plus floor, trim/window and optional daylight layers separated by technical masks/cutting, never repainting

produce.strategy: production body-matched exact overlay, technical split from each clean cabinet master
produce.dimensions: same registration as cabinet canvas, or cropped with explicit offset

semantic.implementation: Fixed logical scene canvas with uniformly scaled composition container; one origin and one scale applied to all layers. Do not reflow furniture individually or stretch room to viewport.
semantic.notes: HTML/CSS or WPF scene composition owns placement and alpha-independent draw bounds.

semantic.implementation: Keep application navigation, status bars, labels, buttons, wallets and scene rounded clipping in component/layout code outside raster plate.
semantic.notes: Approved mock UI is not production image content.

semantic.implementation: Existing animated species sprite plus independent floor contact shadow at pet ground anchor, above decor layers.
semantic.notes: No pet baked into rug or bed; preserve awake central pet.

semantic.implementation: Render current relevant trophy alpha as solid single-colour silhouette in album using mask; no internal details and no additional raster per locked state.
semantic.notes: Do not expose future chain art before unlock.

semantic.implementation: Model metadata supplies top/shelf anchors, trophy scale, front-lip overlay and support mask. Draw object then support contact shadow then attached item then edge overlay; child positions recompute on furniture swap.
semantic.notes: CSS/WPF owns stacking and shadow registration; raster owns intrinsic perspective/material.

production_manifest_opinion.output_path_policy: Parent production manifest owns final filenames. Assets stay in docs/design-v2/art-production/assets; raw atlases, references and masks in sibling sources/review. This geometry file does not claim raster files already exist.

asset_registration.rule: Measure generated dimensions and alpha bounds. Uniformly map the opaque subject to logical_draw_wh and preserve aspect; do not derive scene scale from atlas-cell size or transparent padding. Never stretch an image to satisfy requested master dimensions.
asset_registration.alpha_padding: Small cutouts: >=8 logical pixels clear on each side, except natural intrinsic trailing leaves. Floor plants >=10; frames >=4; rugs/beds >=10. At 4x scale these are32/40/16/40 master pixels. Actual generator padding may differ and must be measured.
asset_registration.shadow_padding: Contact shadow is separate or explicitly registered companion, up to12 logical pixels around ground footprint; never fill whole atlas cell with grey cast shadow.
asset_registration.atlases: User allows small transparent atlases and Python cutting/alignment/scaling without repainting. Equal cells are packaging only; retain per-sprite alpha bounds and support anchors, and reject any cell collision or cut subject.

qa_requirements: Compare every object silhouette/material/palette with its approved furniture/model/room reference; no baked trophies/plants/text/UI.
Check all four cabinet bodies with the three largest trophy stages simultaneously plus maximum allowed upper plant; shelf lip hides base edge only, not trophy details.
Check each T model with tallest allowable small plant; table surface and plant bottom remain in contact and outside central pet ground polygon.
Check each chair with each floor species; alpha gaps and contact footprints decide collisions, not overlapping broad bounding boxes.
Check tallest D3 with bed and right picture; dresser must not crowd Mew frame or side bed, and narrow form remains narrow.
Check all curtains with biggest allowed windowsill plant; retain complete canopy/visible pot and enough outdoor opening.
Render empty starter, maximum-fill room and swap contact-sheet composites on the same scene coordinates; static previews only.
Record actual master dimensions, alpha bounds, local anchors and scale factors for every cut PNG. No fake transparent checkerboard or opaque margin accepted.

assumptions: All approved source rectangles measured by visual inspection are approximate within8px; production alpha/support points replace them after generation.
Master dimensions are preferred resolution targets, not promises from imagegen. Logical draw sizes and world anchors are the actual placement contract.
Non-reference decor variants follow agreed model taxonomy and palette family; geometry does not invent palette names or new purchasable species.
Per-model cabinet surface deltas and non-approved furniture scene sizes are production constraints derived from approved proportions, requiring final static validation.
No implementation or pet sprite production is included in this geometry assignment.
